info.description: I build fast, accessible web interfaces and pragmatic backends. My strengths are clean UI with HTML/CSS/Tailwind and modern JS/TS, plus data-driven features with Next.js and PostgreSQL. I also craft WordPress solutions when they're the right fit.
info.description2: Currently sharpening Next.js and Laravel to deliver production‑ready features end to end. I enjoy collaborative Git workflows, care about UX, and love turning ideas into polished, useful products.
